title: Close acceptance gaps and assemble reviewer evidence
objective: A reviewer can determine whether the full product is ready without reading implementation chats.
outcome: Each R01-R16 and F01-F33 maps to exact accepted PRs, commits, test receipts and remaining limitations. A missing witness or failed requirement remains open regardless of model consensus or code completion. Handoffs, guides, runbooks and publication manifests are checked for orphan artifacts and undeclared exceptions. Astra final review findings cannot grant themselves owner authority. Only a fully evidenced candidate proceeds to release preparation. R01-R16 remain unaccepted. C-009-1 remains unresolved. 8+8 actual participants remain unavailable. Last-good generation live-2026-09-03-85b50522b420 is unchanged. HTTP 200 is not a completed research task. Readiness is evidenced by outcomes, not the number of commits.
